Denne hjemmeside bruger cookies

Vi bruger cookies til at tilpasse vores indhold og annoncer, til at vise dig funktioner til sociale medier og til at analysere vores trafik. Vi deler også oplysninger om din brug af vores website med vores partnere inden for sociale medier, annonceringspartnere og analysepartnere. Vores partnere kan kombinere disse data med andre oplysninger, du har givet dem, eller som de har indsamlet fra din brug af deres tjenester.

* Nødvendig 3
  
  Nødvendige cookies hjælper med at gøre en hjemmeside brugbar ved at aktivere grundlæggende funktioner såsom side-navigation og adgang til sikre områder af hjemmesiden. Hjemmesiden kan ikke fungere ordentligt uden disse cookies.

        **CookieConsent** Gemmer brugerens cookie-samtykke-tilstand for det aktuelle domæne.
        
        **Maksimal opbevaringstid** : 1 år **Type** : HTTP Cookie

        **PHPSESSID** Bevarer brugertilstand på tværs af sideforespørgsler.

        **Maksimal opbevaringstid** : Session **Type** : Lokalt HTML-lager
* Præferencer 3
  
  Præference cookies gør det muligt for en hjemmeside at huske oplysninger, der ændrer den måde hjemmesiden ser ud eller opfører sig på. F.eks. dit foretrukne sprog, eller den region, du befinder dig i.

Om

Cookies er små tekstfiler, som kan bruges af websteder til at gøre en brugers oplevelse mere effektiv.  
  
Loven fastslår, at vi kan gemme cookies på din enhed, hvis de er strengt nødvendige for at sikre leveringen af den tjeneste, du udtrykkeligt har anmodet om at bruge. For alle andre typer cookies skal vi indhente dit samtykke.  
  
Dette websted bruger forskellige typer af cookies. Nogle cookies sættes af tredjeparts tjenester, der vises på vores sider.  
  
Du kan til enhver tid ændre eller tilbagetrække dit samtykke fra Cookiedeklarationen på vores hjemmeside.  
  
Få mere at vide om, hvem vi er, hvordan du kan kontakte os, og hvordan vi behandler persondata i vores Privatlivspolitik.

# Past exhibitions

[### House Beautiful 28\.4.26 - 23.8.26 In the South Wing, you can experience a rich and varied selection of works from the museum's collection: painting, video, sculpture and photography, created and collected over almost seven decades. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/louisiana-collection-summer-2026/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Sophie Calle 26\.3.26 - 6.9.26 With her original mix of fact and fiction, seriousness and playfulness, distance and intimacy, Sophie Calle stands as one of the most influential voices of contemporary art. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/sophie-calle/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Basquiat – Headstrong 30\.1.26 - 17.5.26 With loans from collectors around the world, this show will bring together, for the first time, many of the most important head images on paper by legendary Jean-Michel Basquiat. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/basquiat-headstrong/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Memoryscapes 22\.1.26 - 17.5.26 The second exhibition in the series Architecture Connecting presents two studios that delve into the past in the search for solutions that can benefit the present and form a bridge to the future. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/memoryscapes/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Louisiana’s new works 2\.12.25 - 6.4.26 A large-scale presentation of new works that Louisiana's collection has been enriched with in the years from 2022 to 2025. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/louisianas-new-works-2022-2025/ "Read about the exhibition")

[You the World and I, 2010. © Jon Rafman Courtesy the artist and Sprüth Magers ### Jon Rafman 8\.10.25 - 11.1.26 Jon Rafman's seminal work, Nine Eyes, which first began back in 2008, focuses on both the everyday and the existential aspects of life in the day and age of digital surveillance. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/jon-rafman/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Marisol 1\.10.25 - 22.2.26 Louisiana presents the first comprehensive exhibition in Europe with the Venezuelan-American artist Marisol (1930-2016). She stands as one of the most radical and visionary artists of her generation. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/marisol/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Bouchra Khalili 25\.6.25 - 30.11.25 Moroccan-French artist Bouchra Khalili develops collaborative strategies of storytelling with members of communities excluded from citizen membership. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/bouchra-khalili/ "Read about the exhibition")

[### Tideline – Works from the collection 18\.6.25 - 14.9.25 A walk through the historical part of the collection, from modern classics from the years following the Second World War through Op and Pop Art up until the present day. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/tideline-works-from-the-collection/ "Read about the exhibition")

[Daniel Richter, Ohne Titel, 2008 ### Looking Closer 27\.5.25 - 26.10.25 Louisiana presents a large selection of works on paper from the museum's. Come take a closer look at artistic ideation and the process of creation. Read about the exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/looking-closer/ "Read about the exhibition")
